subject.title: fix(codex): stop Computer Use readiness stalls across fallbacks

question: Should OpenClaw make `AgentHarnessPreflightError` a public Plugin SDK contract for all model-independent harness startup failures, and should this branch be the canonical resolution instead of the overlapping open implementation?
rationale: The patch’s fallback behavior is technically coherent, but exporting a new SDK error class commits the project to semantics that other plugins may depend on; choosing between overlapping live branches is also a maintainer ownership decision.

options.title: Approve the generic preflight contract
options.body: Keep the public typed error, document its model-independent fallback semantics, and reconcile or supersede the overlapping Codex implementation before landing.

options.title: Keep the behavior Codex-private
options.body: Replace the public SDK export with an existing generic mechanism or a narrower internal seam if maintainers do not want this fallback control point to become plugin API.

options.title: Consolidate into the related PR
options.body: Move the validated pieces into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/113232 if maintainers prefer that branch as the single canonical Computer Use fix.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic preflight contract
recommendation.body: Keep the public typed error, document its model-independent fallback semantics, and reconcile or supersede the overlapping Codex implementation before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: The author is a repository member and the branch directly introduces both the Codex behavior and the proposed public SDK contract.
